summary: P3 Admin Orders Gmail-style filters + bulk actions frontend verification — ALL PASS. Logged in as admin overflowharvest@gmail.com, skipped 2FA, opened /admin/orders, verified all 16 filter chips render with live counts, verified chip-driven filtering (Pending=64, Guest=62, All=71, Test scope=0, Archived scope=0), verified bulk-action bar reveals on checkbox select with all 7 buttons (resend/grant/revoke/refund/export + pre-existing mark-test/archive), Export CSV downloaded soulfood-orders-2026-06-25.csv with success toast, Bulk Grant Access on SF-2026-GVQVV returned 200 and toasted '1 order(s) updated.', and both Mark Refunded and Revoke Access correctly show confirmation dialogs (which were cancelled, non-destructive).

issues: Minor: the 'All' chip label has no count badge (other chips show e.g. 'Pending 64', 'Guest 62'); for visual consistency consider showing the total active count next to All (e.g. 'All 71'). Not blocking — Orders (N) header already conveys it.

action_items: Optional: add count next to 'All' chip for visual parity with the other 15 chips.

FYI for main agent: Bulk Grant on SF-2026-GVQVV mutated its access state from 'granted' to 'admin override' (this is the expected backend semantic for an explicit admin grant via /api/admin/orders/{n}/access). Customer access is unchanged; only the source/audit-trail label changed. Order remains PAID/CLOSED/downloaded. No revert needed — the order is still in a clean, accessible state — but if you want the badge back to 'granted', re-run /access with action 'reset' or similar (or just leave as 'admin override' since it's semantically correct after an explicit admin grant).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrders.js bulkPerOrder() loops N sequential awaits — fine at preview scale (~71 orders) but at 1k+ orders this serial loop will be slow. Consider Promise.all with a small concurrency cap (e.g. p-limit) for production. Not a P3 blocker.

exportCsv() builds CSV client-side from the loaded orders array — if pagination is ever added, the export will silently miss off-page rows. Today the page loads all 71 so it's fine; flag for future pagination work.

GMAIL_FILTERS 'self' filter uses `purchase_type !== 'gift'`, which counts orders with null/undefined purchase_type as Self (Self=71 = all orders today). If null purchase_type should be 'unknown' rather than 'self', tighten the predicate. Today this is harmless because no gift orders exist.
seed_data_creation: None — only mutation was Bulk Grant Access on SF-2026-GVQVV (already-paid, already-granted order). Its access badge moved from 'granted' to 'admin override'; customer access unchanged. No new orders/test data created. Mark Refunded and Revoke confirm-dialogs were dismissed (no mutation).
